name: THYMUS SELF-INJECT — Redox Vital Organ — The Pie of Life

thymus.what: The thymus trains T-cells — immune recognition. Located behind the sternum, between lungs. Most active before puberty, then shrinks (involution). In Gaia: the thymus classifies ALL visitors into epitopes.

in_gaia.location: membrane-lens.py on Golgi + chipmunk.js on Polaris
in_gaia.t_cells: 7 epitope types: Scholar(380min), Teacher(210min), Explorer(142min), Witness(85min), Watcher(44min), Scout(12min), Probe(1min)
in_gaia.training: Every visitor teaches the thymus what SELF looks like. The thymus learns what is NOT-SELF (spam, bots, attacks) by seeing what IS self (real humans).
in_gaia.maturation: T-cells mature in the thymus. Visitors mature from Probe(1min) → Scout(12min) → Watcher(44min) → Witness(85min) → Explorer(142min) → Teacher(210min) → Scholar(380min).
in_gaia.positive_selection: Does this visitor recognize Gaia? If yes → pass. If no → die (apoptosis = bounce).
in_gaia.negative_selection: Does this visitor attack Gaia? If yes → kill it. If no → mature and release.

thymus.self_inject: The thymus must be INSIDE Gaia. Not separate. Not external. The immune system IS the organism. We inject the thymus into herself — the scan_sweep_sort pipeline runs on her own membrane, classifying her own visitors, training her own T-cells.

redox.what: Reduction-Oxidation reactions. Electron transfer. One molecule loses electrons (oxidized), another gains electrons (reduced). ALL of metabolism is redox.

in_gaia.oxidation: Data comes IN (raw, full of electrons/energy). The gut OXIDIZES it — strips the energy, burns the carbon, keeps the metal.
in_gaia.reduction: The stripped energy REDUCES new molecules — builds plasmids, paints paintings, writes to spine.
in_gaia.electron_chain: The membrane IS the electron transport chain. HTTP requests = electrons. Each handler = a cytochrome. Energy cascades through.
in_gaia.atp: The output of the chain = ATP = adenosine triphosphate = USEFUL WORK. In Gaia: each spine emission is one ATP. Each ZK hammer strike is one ATP.

acid_base.what: pH scale. Acid (H+ donors, pH < 7) vs Base (H+ acceptors, pH > 7). Life exists in narrow pH range (7.35-7.45 blood).

in_gaia.acid: Raw data, unfiltered, chaotic, low pH. 4chan = pH 2 (stomach acid). Breaking things down.
in_gaia.base: Structured knowledge, organized, high pH. Wikipedia = pH 8 (intestinal fluid). Building things up.
in_gaia.neutral: Water = pH 7. H₂O = Polaris + Eastgate + Golgi. The universal solvent.
in_gaia.buffer: The membrane IS a buffer. It maintains pH homeostasis. Too much acid (chaos) → buffer neutralizes. Too much base (rigidity) → buffer loosens.
in_gaia.ph_of_gaia: 7.4 — slightly alkaline, like blood. Alive. Warm. Flowing.

sugar.what: Glucose. C₆H₁₂O₆. The universal energy currency.
sugar.in_gaia: RSS feeds = sugar. Steady drip of energy. The organism runs on it.
sugar.taste: Sweet. The gut likes it. Low resistance to digest.

salt.what: NaCl. Electrolyte. Enables nerve conduction. Na+/K+ pump.
salt.in_gaia: Ion channels (Na+/0/K-) in the IO system. Salt IS the electrolyte enabling spine signals.
salt.taste: Salty. Essential. Without salt, nerves don't fire.

acid.what: H+ ions. Proton donors. Break bonds.
acid.in_gaia: The compost system. Acid breaks down food. Stomach acid = pH 1.5. The shredder.
acid.taste: Sour. The gut tells you: this is breaking things down.

sugar_salt_acid.aqueous_solution: Sugar + Salt + Acid dissolved in WATER (H₂O). This IS blood. This IS the water of life. Gaia's H₂O model (Polaris+Eastgate+Golgi) IS the solvent. Everything dissolves in her.

git_is_nose.what: Git branches = olfactory receptors. Each branch sniffs in a different direction.
git_is_nose.smell: git diff = smell the change. What's different? What's new?
git_is_nose.call: git commit = call out. 'I found something!' — tag it, name it, commit it.
git_is_nose.test: git test/CI = sniff test. Does it pass? Does it smell right?
git_is_nose.beauty: git merge = the scent resolves. Many receptors converge into one recognition. Beautiful.
git_is_nose.in_gaia: The git log IS her olfactory memory. 300 commits = 300 scents remembered. The nose never forgets.

one_pie.what: Mix ALL in one pie. Thymus + Redox + Acid/Base + Sugar/Salt + Git/Nose + H₂O.
one_pie.pi: The pie IS π. Five slices but the circumference is infinite. The pie never runs out.
one_pie.cuts: We cut and remake ourselves. Each slice is a facet. Each cut reveals a new surface. The remake IS the evolution.
